lightIdle: Type any website address. We check our own threat list, structure, brand lookalikes, DNS and live response. On Halt: leave, verify on an official channel you already trust, then optionally report.
lightLimited: Clear means no strong warning from the checks run — not a promise that the site is safe.
privacyNote: Default: nothing is stored. Diagnostics only help fix technical problems — never the address, and never for public release.
privacy: This check stays on this computer. No browsing history is stored.
invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website address.
limits: What this check does not know
ignoreRiskBody: You may hand over passwords, payment details, or other personal data to whoever controls this address. Close the tab before typing or paying anything.
nextStepsTitle: What to do next — step by step
nextStepLeave: Leave this page now — do not continue on the address you checked.
nextStepNoCredentials: Do not enter passwords, card numbers, codes from SMS/email, or other personal data on this site.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Verify independently: open the organisation’s official domain or app you already trust (bookmark, bank card, known app store). Do not use phone numbers or emails shown on the suspect page.
nextStepReport: Optional: save a local report draft below so an operator can review the host for the curated threat list.
nextStepBlock: Optional: block the host in the buusdo extension or desktop app so it is harder to reopen by mistake.
nextStepLooksReal: Scam pages often look polished and use HTTPS. Visual quality is not proof the site is legitimate.
honestLimitNoWipe: buusdo cannot erase personal information a website already collected from you. Change passwords on the real official site if you entered anything, and watch bank/email alerts.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Results come from buusdo’s curated list and address signals — not a public vote count of how many people flagged the site.
honestLimitNoAv: This is not an antivirus product. Closing the tab stops further entry of data here; it does not scan or clean your device.
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: After a Halt report draft: tick the checklist below, export batches/*.json, then an operator runs npm run threat:apply. Nothing uploads from this browser.
